svg.title: CarCYD - ESP32 car dashboard and OBD-II display for the Cheap Yellow Display
svg.desc: Banner showing the ESP32-2432S028R Cheap Yellow Display running the firmware: the gauge cluster with the tachometer ring, speed, engine speed and gear changing while the car accelerates, shifts and brakes.

text.tspan: Gauge cluster, live OBD-II data and fault codes
